segments.name: Airline
segments.description: Operates a low-cost passenger airline selling scheduled nonstop flights, ancillary air-related products, third party travel products, and fixed fee charter services to leisure travelers.
segments.evidence: The Airline segment operates as a single business unit and includes all scheduled service air transportation, ancillary air-related products and services, third party products and services, fixed fee contract air transportation and other airline-related revenue.

segments.name: Sunseeker Resort
segments.description: Operated a resort hotel with rooms, meeting facilities, dining and a golf course until its sale in September 2025.
segments.evidence: The Sunseeker Resort segment was operated as a single business unit and included hotel rooms and suites for occupancy, group meeting facilities, food and beverage options, Aileron Golf Course and other Resort amenities.

revenueModel.text: Leisure travelers pay for scheduled air transportation, optional ancillary air-related products, third party travel products, and fixed fee charter arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: We operate a low-cost, low utilization passenger airline marketed primarily to leisure travelers in under-served cities, allowing us to sell air transportation both on a stand-alone basis and bundled with the sale of air-related and third party services and products.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold Sunseeker Resort and is now managed as a single Airline operating segment.
changes.evidence: Subsequent to the sale of Sunseeker Resort in September 2025, the Company is managed as a single Airline operating segment.

changes.text: In 2026, the Company announced a proposed acquisition of Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc., expected to close in the second half of 2026.
changes.evidence: On January 11, 2026, we announced that we plan to acquire Sun Country Airlines Holdings, Inc. ("Sun Country") pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement").
